{{Quote|You are never more than ten minutes from a fully staffed medical facility.|Excerpt from the Imperial Manual of the Soldier|<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Imperial Manual of the Soldier''''' was a document made available to members of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Among its contents was a reminder that [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were within ten minutes of a medical facility with a complete staff, though at least one Imperial [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] believed this fact was of little value to a soldier reduced to ashes.
